hint: Put the ID card in the reader. The name, birth date, gender and photo are filled in; check them before saving.
error_not_running: The card reader program is not running on this computer. Install or start “SCardReadServer”, then try again.
error_reader_off: The card reader is not ready. Check that the reader is plugged in and that the Windows “Smart Card” service is running, then try again.
error_no_card: No card could be read. Check that the card is in the reader, then try again.
error_failed: The card could not be read. Take the card out, put it back, and try again. If it keeps happening with this card, the card reader program on this computer may need updating.
error_service_error: The card reader gave an unexpected answer. Try again. If it keeps happening, restart the card reader program on this computer.
apply_hint: Tick what to take from the card. Details that already match are left as they are.
other_person: The CPR on this card is different from the one on file. It may be someone else’s card: nothing is ticked. Tick details only if you are sure.
use_photo_hint: Replaces the current photo. Only if you tick it.
no_photo: This card gave no usable photo.
